The '''NightBlind 472''' was a [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]] made by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It cost 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed one [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]]. It operated by flooding an area with static that would blind optical and energy reading sensors. Due to the static discharge, it made the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that it was installed on much more easier to detect but next to impossible to identify.
